site_name: Land at Benenden Hospital, South of Goddards Green Road, East End - South East Quadrant
evidence_slice: Tunbridge Wells Borough Council's adopted 2025 interactive policies map exposes layer 11 'Site Allocations in Benenden Neighbourhood Plan', and the National Data Library resource provides a GeoJSON download for that layer with data last updated 2025-12-12. The made Benenden Neighbourhood Development Plan identifies Site Specific Policy 3 (SSP3) as Land at Benenden Hospital, South of Goddards Green Road, East End - South East Quadrant, allocated for residential development to provide up to an additional 25 residential units. The Council's December 2025 schedule of map changes states that the former AL/BE3 boundary was replaced with the Benenden NDP SSP3 site-allocation boundary.
